## Complete Orient before Week 1

Read all eight Orient pages in this order. Watch the ten short lessons on the video page, then begin the weekly notes.

1. **How to use this site** — you are here; see how the sections fit together.
2. [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) — understand one low-altitude service and the words used for it.
3. [Course overview](overview.qmd) — see what the course covers and how the weeks connect.
4. [How does LAE work?](business-overview.qmd) — see the business side of a service.
5. [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd) — learn the regulator roles and key cautions.
6. [Common questions](faq.qmd) — read the ten short answers.
7. [Key numbers](key-figures.qmd) — distinguish sourced figures from classroom examples.
8. [LAE 101 videos](videos.qmd) — watch all ten short lessons.

**After page 8:** start [Week 1](week-01.qmd). From there, follow the weekly lecture notes under **Teach**.

For a term or a dated programme claim, use the [Glossary](glossary.qmd) or [Official status](tracker.qmd).

**Next in Orient:** [What is LAE?](primer.qmd).

## Then Teach

Classroom worked examples use round figures for learning — cite [Key numbers](key-figures.qmd) and [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd#standing-caveats) for programme facts.

- **Teach** menu — one page per week (notes, summary, readings, plus a class-outline PDF). Start with [Week 1](week-01.qmd).  
- Each week page is the main notes. The PDF is a shorter class outline — not a substitute for the note.
- **Self-check** — short multiple-choice questions at the end of each week page (Weeks 1–12; private practice; nothing is stored). Example: [Week 1 · Self-check](week-01.qmd#self-check). All weeks also collected under Review: [Self-check](quizzes.qmd).

## Review

Formulas, tables, figures, readings, and Self-check quizzes collected from the week notes.

- [Formulas](formulas.qmd) — named teaching identities from the week notes.
- [Tables](tables.qmd) — named teaching tables from the week notes.
- [Figures](figures.qmd) — teaching diagrams from the week notes.
- [Readings](readings.qmd) — documents listed on the week notes.
- [Self-check](quizzes.qmd) — practice questions from Weeks 1–12 (same MCQs as on each week page).
